privacy.p1: The company uses your information only as permitted by Algerian law and with strict respect for privacy. Protecting privacy is a core principle for us.
privacy.p2: By using our services, you agree that your personal data may be transferred to and stored on our servers (Algeria / France / other) and used to provide the service, personalize your experience, prevent fraud, and improve our services.
privacy.p3: Cookies: we use cookies on some pages to analyze traffic, personalize content, measure promotional effectiveness, and support trust and security. You can refuse cookies if your browser allows it, but some features may stop working.
privacy.p4: Marketing: Bi3oo.com does not sell or rent your personal data to third parties for marketing without your explicit consent.
privacy.p5: Retention: data is kept as required (withdrawal of consent / objection / end of business relationship), generally for one (1) year from registration (references: laws 18-07 and 09-04).

about.heroTitle: Bi3oo — the marketplace that connects supply and demand
about.heroLead: Bi3oo is an online classifieds platform for individuals and businesses: one place to buy, sell, rent, or promote your services—with a simple, structured experience.
about.missionP1: Give everyone the tools to publish, search, and close deals in the best conditions: a clear interface, rich categories, and support from posting a listing down to the details. Bi3oo aims to be your go-to for efficient, local discovery.
about.pillarsSubtitle: A product vision focused on clarity, diverse listings, and direct relationships between users.
about.pillar1Text: Vehicles, real estate, jobs, tech, home, fashion, services… Bi3oo brings together the listings that matter in one clear, structured space.
about.pillar2Text: Whether you’re selling a second-hand item or growing a business, the platform adapts: simple flows for individuals, visibility and tools for pros.
about.pillar3Text: We encourage direct, transparent exchanges between buyers and sellers for more human, readable transactions.
about.pillar4Text: Terms of use, privacy, and reporting: Bi3oo is designed as a structured environment for quality listings.
about.hl1Detail: Geo-aware listings and wilaya search to find what’s near you.
about.hl2Detail: Category-specific forms so you can publish quickly with the right fields.
about.hl3Detail: Offers, wanted ads, and services—one ecosystem to buy, rent, or promote your activity.
about.wordsP1: Our platform brings together classifieds across automotive, real estate, jobs, electronics, home, fashion, and more. The goal: save your time with structured listings and flows tailored to each type of item.
about.wordsP2: You can post a listing for free, highlight your offer, and reach buyers or service providers. For businesses, Bi3oo is also a visibility lever with a broad, engaged audience.
about.wordsQuote: Buying, selling, or connecting: we believe in simple, direct, responsible exchanges—peer-to-peer spirit, supported by technology and clear rules for everyone.
about.ctaJoinLead: Browse listings, create yours, or write to us with any questions about the platform.
